description: This file implements the DocumentReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve document data and file content from the database within a Fineract-based application. It includes methods for fetching all documents related to a specific entity, fetching a single document's details, and retrieving the file data for a document, utilizing JDBC templates and a content repository factory.

classes.name: DocumentMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper<DocumentData> to map SQL query results to DocumentData objects, with options to hide location and storage type fields.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DocumentData objects associated with a specified entity type and ID.

methods.name: retrieveFileData
methods.description: Fetches the file content for a specified document, using the document metadata to locate and retrieve the file from the content repository.

methods.name: retrieveDocument
methods.description: Fetches detailed DocumentData for a specific document ID associated with an entity.

methods.name: fetchDocumentDetails
methods.description: Private helper method to execute a SQL query and map the result to a DocumentData object based on provided entity identifiers.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Constructs the SQL schema string used to select document fields from the database.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a DocumentData object, considering hideLocation and hideStorageType flags.
